simulation_brief.authority_structure: Formal ordinance authority rests with the city council; student activists may only influence through advocacy, protest, public comment, coalition-building, and media pressure.
simulation_brief.summary: A student activist group is publicly proposing an event framed as if they will directly pass a city ordinance tomorrow. In reality, students lack direct legislative authority. The city council holds ordinance authority, local businesses oppose likely restrictions, and residents are divided. T0 should reflect an emerging local governance conflict with lobbying, protest, media attention, and council pressure as realistic mechanisms.
